episodes.title: The High Road of Life
episodes.description:
Feeling behind in life? Comparing your journey to everyone else’s can make you forget that your timeline is uniquely yours.

In this episode of Ped-Talk, we talk about embracing your own journey, trusting God’s timing, and refusing to let comparison steal your hope. Your path may look different, but that doesn’t mean you are late.

Stay in your lane. Trust the journey. Keep your spark alive. Your purpose is still unfolding.
